statement: Pinned Cemu native Wiimote HIDAPI discovery filters Nintendo 0x057e products 0x0306 and 0x0330 and explicitly skips product strings equal to Nintendo RVL-CNT-01-UC; this is an exclusion from that native Wiimote entrypoint, not a conclusion about Cemu's generic gamepad input paths.

applicability.revision: Wii U Pro; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: Native HIDAPI enumerator only; other Cemu input APIs have not been evaluated.
